_comment: Single source of truth for system-wide energy/power policy on the Surface Pro 8 host. All thresholds, idle timers, lid/power-button behaviour, and CPU profile bindings live here. Consumed by host modules (configuration_security.nix, configuration_power.nix) and the home-manager flake (ba_flakes_desktop/.../plasma.nix → PowerDevil + kscreenlockerrc). Replicated verbatim in ba_flakes_desktop/src/modules/desktop/cloud-data-power.json because Nix pure-eval flakes cannot read paths outside their own source root. The battery-watchdog (cloud-data-battery-protection.json) keeps its own per-voter thresholds: those describe the LAST-RESORT tier that does not trust the SAM data path.

thresholds._comment: Battery percentage thresholds shared by upowerd + PowerDevil. critical_pct = where the healthy-SAM path (UPower CriticalPowerAction) hibernates; it MUST match the watchdog's bat_capacity.critical_pct so every layer agrees. Owner requirement 2026-06-13: hibernation at 15% ONLY — above that the energy plan only locks/screensaves on idle (idle_minutes), no capacity-based action until 15%. warn/low are advisory notifications above critical.

idle_minutes._comment: Minutes of user inactivity before each step. lock applies on both AC and Battery (security is power-source-independent). null disables a step. hibernate DISABLED on idle 2026-07-09 (owner requirement: hibernation triggers on battery-level ONLY — see thresholds.critical_pct / actions.critical — never on idle time, on AC or battery). Idle still locks the screen; it just never auto-hibernates.

events._comment: Hardware-event handlers. Allowed verbs: lock, ignore, hibernate, poweroff. Sleep/suspend are never permitted (see actions.never).

actions._comment: Verb policy. critical = what every layer tries on critical-battery hit. low/warn = notification-only. The 'never' list is a HARD GUARD: every consumer reading this JSON MUST refuse to emit configuration that maps any event/threshold to a banned verb. Surface Pro 8 SAM/DRM suspend (S3, s2idle) is unreliable: surface_hid reprobe fails, DRM atomic commit errors, logind marks the session Active=no which makes kscreenlocker reject correct passwords. Therefore sleep/suspend stay banned forever — use hibernate or lock instead.

pre_hibernate_warning._comment: Universal pre-hibernate countdown + cancel gate. Injects an ExecStartPre on systemd-hibernate.service so EVERY hibernation path (battery-watchdog, UPower critical, KDE Plasma idle, manual `systemctl hibernate`) is delayed by `delay_seconds` and announces itself first via journal + wall (terminal broadcast, carries the inline cancel command) + notify-send (desktop). NO hibernation is immediate. Set delay_seconds=0 to disable the countdown (the invariant preflight gate still runs). channels.* gate which announcement vectors are used.
pre_hibernate_warning._status_note: RE-ENABLED 2026-06-13 (owner requirement: ANY hibernation trigger must first pop up a 30s cancellable warning, on desktop AND in the terminal). Re-imported in configuration.nix; testers restored below.

channels._comment: journal = log; wall = broadcast to every terminal (carries the inline cancel command); notify_send = KDE corner toast (fallback); dialog_center = CENTERED kdialog modal with a Cancel button — the primary cancel UI, also serves as the countdown wait.

kernel._comment: Kernel power-management cmdline options. mem_sleep_default=deep forces S3 over s2idle so any rogue suspend attempt fails fast (S3 is broken too, but at least it errors out instead of half-sleeping forever in s2idle). Appended to boot.kernelParams.

cpu_profile._comment: power-profiles-daemon profile target per power source. Auto-switching is driven by the KDE Plasma battery applet; this is the declared intent — the runtime daemon honors it. Not enforced in a service; informational + future-driven.

consumers: aa_nixos-surface_host/src/modules/configuration_pre-hibernate-warning.nix (ExecStartPre on systemd-hibernate.service — 30s cancellable warning gate, all hibernation paths — pre_hibernate_warning.*)

testers._comment: Each invariant verifies one consumer is using the configured value. Run after any threshold/timer change.

checks.description: logind lid action on battery matches events.lid_close.battery (logind keys are NOT exposed via systemctl show — read the conf file directly)
logind lid action on AC matches events.lid_close.ac
logind lid action when docked matches events.lid_close.docked
logind HandlePowerKey matches events.power_button.short (last-occurrence wins per systemd-logind merge order)

kernel cmdline forces deep sleep (no s2idle) per kernel.mem_sleep_default. Reads /proc/cmdline (always-current truth, bootloader-agnostic). Requires a reboot for changes from boot.json to take effect.

/etc/systemd/sleep.conf hard-bans suspend at the systemd-sleep layer (actions.never contains a suspend-family verb → AllowSuspend=no). This is what stops a rogue `systemctl suspend` from s2idle-hanging the SP8; mem_sleep_default can't (no S3 on this hardware).
/etc/systemd/sleep.conf still allows hibernation (critical-battery action + reboot-with-session both need S4). Guards against over-broad Allow*=no that would break the intended sleep path.
PowerDevil BatteryCriticalLevel matches thresholds.critical_pct (run as user)
PowerDevil BatteryLowLevel matches thresholds.low_pct (run as user)
PowerDevil [Battery][SuspendAndShutdown] AutoSuspendIdleTimeoutSec is 0 (disabled) — idle_minutes.battery.hibernate=null, hibernation is battery-level-only (run as user)
PowerDevil [AC][SuspendAndShutdown] AutoSuspendIdleTimeoutSec is 0 (disabled) — idle_minutes.ac.hibernate=null, hibernation is battery-level-only (run as user)
kscreenlockerrc Daemon.Timeout (minutes) matches idle_minutes.battery.lock (run as user)
systemd-hibernate.service has an ExecStartPre pointing at hibernate-prewarn — proves the universal 30s warning gate is wired on EVERY hibernation path
the prewarn wrapper bakes in delay_seconds from pre_hibernate_warning.delay_seconds (no immediate hibernation)
hibernate-cancel command is installed so the inline terminal cancel instruction works

deployment._comment: After editing this JSON, the host flake AND the home-manager flake both need a switch (each consumes its own replica).
